claim_text: The boiling point of pure water at one standard atmosphere of pressure is exactly 100 degrees Celsius.
context_excerpt: A physical chemistry lecture explaining thermodynamic state variables and calibrated thermometer measurements.
epistemic_summary: Truth is established by direct correspondence between the proposition and empirical physical observation.
quote_evidences: Laboratory mercury and platinum resistance thermometers measure phase transition at precisely 100 degrees C at 101.325 kPa.

claim_text: The speed of light in a vacuum is 299,792,458 meters per second.
context_excerpt: An optics handbook describing laser interferometry experiments verifying universal constants.
epistemic_summary: Direct measurement and physical constants establish factual truth grounded in empirical reality.
quote_evidences: Cavity resonance and laser frequency combs confirm the invariant photon propagation speed in vacuum.

claim_text: The James Webb Space Telescope detected redshifted Lyman-alpha emissions from galaxy JADES-GS-z14-0.
context_excerpt: An astrophysics paper detailing near-infrared spectrograph grating observations of deep field cosmic origins.
epistemic_summary: Observational instrumentation data directly corroborates the spatial proposition.
quote_evidences: Spectrometric photon detector readouts identify the distinct Lyman break at redshift z=14.32.

claim_text: DNA polymerase III synthesizes nascent leading strands strictly in the 5-prime to 3-prime direction.
context_excerpt: A molecular biology textbook detailing crystal structure mechanics and phosphodiester bond formation.
epistemic_summary: Biochemical structural assays and X-ray crystallography demonstrate physical molecular mechanisms.
quote_evidences: Radiolabeled nucleotide tracking reveals that hydroxyl attack occurs exclusively at the 3-prime terminal carbon.

claim_text: Seismic P-waves travel through the Earth's liquid outer core while S-waves are refracted and attenuated.
context_excerpt: A geophysics treatise on planetary seismology and core-mantle boundary shadow zones.
epistemic_summary: Empirical seismograph recordings across global stations match physical fluid shear mechanics.
quote_evidences: Global seismic stations record the comprehensive disappearance of transverse shear waves at angular distances greater than 104 degrees.

claim_text: The half-life of Carbon-14 is 5,730 years plus or minus 40 years.
context_excerpt: An archaeological dating manual detailing mass spectrometry of radioactive beta decay in organic specimens.
epistemic_summary: Physical radiometric decay observations establish direct correspondence with atomic decay formulas.
quote_evidences: Accelerator mass spectrometry counts remaining C-14 atoms against calibrated dendrochronology rings.

claim_text: In standard set theory with the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms and the Axiom of Choice, the Banach-Tarski paradox necessarily holds.
context_excerpt: A mathematical logic lecture examining non-measurable sets and decomposition theorems.
epistemic_summary: Truth is established strictly by deductive coherence and non-contradiction within an axiomatic formal framework.
quote_evidences: Given the acceptance of ZFC, the decomposition of a unit ball into five disjoint pieces is a logically inescapable deductive consequence.

claim_text: Under classical Marxist historical materialism, the economic base inevitably determines the legal and cultural superstructure.
context_excerpt: A political philosophy seminar analyzing Das Kapital and ideological reproduction in capitalist states.
epistemic_summary: Validity is derived from total systemic alignment with the internal dialectical architecture of the theory.
quote_evidences: The relations of production form the indispensable foundation upon which rises legal and political superstructures.

claim_text: Within Austrian business cycle theory, artificially suppressed interest rates invariably cause capital malinvestment.
context_excerpt: An economic treatise comparing monetary transmission mechanisms and capital structure distortions.
epistemic_summary: The claim derives validity from deductive coherence within praxeological axioms rather than empirical econometric sampling.
quote_evidences: When central banks lower the interest rate below the natural rate, entrepreneurial calculations systematically misallocate capital into longer production stages.

claim_text: In Spinoza's metaphysical system, God and Nature are identical substance with infinite attributes.
context_excerpt: A scholarly commentary on Spinoza's Ethics demonstrated in geometrical order.
epistemic_summary: Truth follows from geometric deductive proofs from definitions and axioms without requiring empirical verification.
quote_evidences: By God I understand a being absolutely infinite; except God, no substance can be or be conceived (Ethics, Prop. 14).

claim_text: In Keynesian macroeconomic models, aggregate demand falling below potential GDP necessarily produces recessionary output gaps.
context_excerpt: A macroeconomic textbook explaining the IS-LM framework and multiplier dynamics.
epistemic_summary: Internal consistency across the interconnected equations and accounting identities defines systemic validity.
quote_evidences: The paradox of thrift demonstrates that collective attempts to increase savings reduce equilibrium income within the closed accounting loop.

claim_text: According to the legal doctrine of originalism, constitutional provisions must be interpreted strictly according to their public meaning at the time of enactment.
context_excerpt: A jurisprudence review article comparing original public meaning jurisprudence with the living constitution doctrine.
epistemic_summary: The proposition's validity stems from adherence to an internal coherent theory of statutory interpretation.
quote_evidences: Constitutional fidelity requires that judges treat the written text as fixing legal meaning at the historical ratification baseline.

claim_text: Newtonian classical mechanics is true for designing civil engineering bridges and skyscraper trusses.
context_excerpt: A structural engineering seminar explaining why relativistic quantum mechanics is discarded in civil construction.
epistemic_summary: The theory is deemed true and adopted because it successfully works and delivers reliable, predictable structural stability.
quote_evidences: In civil design, classical statics calculations yield perfectly safe suspension spans while avoiding computational overhead.

claim_text: Belief in personal free will is true because it fosters moral accountability and positive psychosocial outcomes.
context_excerpt: A pragmatist essay reflecting William James's 'Will to Believe' doctrine in psychological ethics.
epistemic_summary: Truth is evaluated by the experiential, moral, and functional consequences of adopting the belief.
quote_evidences: My first act of free will shall be to believe in free will; its cash-value in human conduct is moral agency and responsibility.

claim_text: Agile Scrum sprint cycles are the right operational model because they accelerate product shipping speed and reduce rework.
context_excerpt: A software engineering management case study evaluating organizational delivery cadences.
epistemic_summary: Truth and correctness are defined by tangible functional utility and organizational performance.
quote_evidences: Two-week iterative sprint retrospectives reduced ticket resolution latency by 42% across sixteen engineering squads.

claim_text: Double-entry bookkeeping is the correct method for maintaining corporate accounts because it prevents unrecorded ledger imbalances.
context_excerpt: A financial accounting handbook explaining the foundational mechanics of debit and credit balancing.
epistemic_summary: The method is true in practice because it reliably prevents fraud and operational errors in commercial transactions.
quote_evidences: The pragmatic verification of double-entry bookkeeping lies in its immediate detection of single-leg posting errors.

claim_text: Fluoridating municipal drinking water is sound public policy because it dramatically decreases childhood dental caries.
context_excerpt: A municipal public health review on cost-benefit analysis of preventative civic interventions.
epistemic_summary: Truth is established by measurable epidemiological efficacy and tangible utilitarian health improvements.
quote_evidences: Every dollar invested in community water fluoridation yields thirty-eight dollars in avoided restorative dental expenditures.

claim_text: Cognitive behavioral therapy is valid because reframing automatic negative thoughts reduces clinical depression symptoms.
context_excerpt: A clinical psychiatry paper reviewing outcome metrics across randomized psychological interventions.
epistemic_summary: Efficacy in restoring functional mental health serves as the ultimate criterion of truth.
quote_evidences: The validity of cognitive reframing is confirmed by significant reductions in Hamilton Depression Rating Scale scores.

claim_text: For low-income tenants facing gentrification, new luxury developments mean displacement and loss of community belonging.
context_excerpt: An urban sociology ethnography capturing qualitative interviews in an urban redevelopment district.
epistemic_summary: Truth is situated within and illuminated by the phenomenological standpoint and lived reality of marginalized residents.
quote_evidences: Long-term residents recount how escalating rents and storefront turnover dismantled social safety nets they relied upon for thirty years.

claim_text: Chronic pain is a subjective reality that only the individual patient can genuinely know and articulate.
context_excerpt: A medical humanities paper discussing pain scales, patient testimony, and clinical skepticism.
epistemic_summary: Epistemic authority resides primarily in first-person experiential awareness rather than external diagnostic imaging.
quote_evidences: Pain is whatever the experiencing person says it is, existing whenever they say it does, immune to total third-person observation.

claim_text: From the perspective of pastoral nomadic communities, national borders are arbitrary colonial impositions that disrupt seasonal grazing.
context_excerpt: An anthropological study of transhumant pastoralists across the Sahel corridor.
epistemic_summary: Validity is grounded in historical indigenous mobility and situated cultural standpoints.
quote_evidences: The elders explain that our livestock follow rainfall and watercourses; the border exists only on paper in distant ministries.

claim_text: For neurodivergent workers, open-plan office acoustics are physically overwhelming sensory environments that prevent focus.
context_excerpt: A workplace ergonomics study documenting neurodivergent cognitive load and workplace design.
epistemic_summary: Truth claims are grounded in distinct neurological vantage points and phenomenological sensory processing.
quote_evidences: Autistic employees describe fluorescent hums and unpredictable auditory chatter as causing rapid sensory exhaustion.

claim_text: The feeling of deep grief over the loss of a parent reveals an existential truth about the fragility of human love.
context_excerpt: A literary memoir reflecting on mourning, memory, and personal identity.
epistemic_summary: Truth emerges from deeply subjective emotional and introspective lived encounters.
quote_evidences: In the stillness of grief, one discovers an undeniable emotional reality that no analytical equation can comprehend.

claim_text: Working frontline night shifts during a pandemic reveals structural hospital vulnerabilities invisible to daytime executives.
context_excerpt: A narrative analysis of registered nurse shift logs during peak emergency room surges.
epistemic_summary: Standpoint epistemology privileges the frontline worker's vantage point as uniquely revealing systemic realities.
quote_evidences: At 3 AM when central supply runs out of PPE, you see the true operational fragility that never appears in corporate dashboards.

claim_text: Anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions are the dominant cause of observed global warming since the mid-20th century.
context_excerpt: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Sixth Assessment Synthesis Report.
epistemic_summary: Truth is certified through exhaustive institutional deliberation, peer review, and collective expert consensus across academies.
quote_evidences: It is unequivocal that human influence has warmed the atmosphere, ocean, and land, endorsed by thousands of scientific authors and 195 member governments.

claim_text: The Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5-TR) classifies Major Depressive Disorder under code 296.xx.
context_excerpt: A clinical psychology licensing guide detailing psychiatric taxonomy standards.
epistemic_summary: Diagnostic criteria derive validity from professional consensus established by the American Psychiatric Association task force.
quote_evidences: Classification boundaries reflect multi-year committee deliberations and formal diagnostic votes across psychiatric specialty boards.

claim_text: The International Astronomical Union reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet in Resolution B5.
context_excerpt: An astronomy history review covering the 2006 Prague IAU General Assembly.
epistemic_summary: The ontological status of Pluto is determined by formal democratic vote among credentialed members of the governing astronomical body.
quote_evidences: Following floor debate, astronomers voted that a planet must clear the neighborhood around its orbit, which Pluto does not satisfy.

claim_text: Standard SI units define the kilogram in terms of the Planck constant rather than a physical prototype cylinder.
context_excerpt: A BIPM treaty document detailing the 26th General Conference on Weights and Measures.
epistemic_summary: Metrological truth is an international institutional pact ratified by national measurement institutes.
quote_evidences: Delegates unanimously voted to retire the International Prototype Kilogram in favor of fixing Planck's constant at 6.62607015e-34 J s.

claim_text: The Geneva Conventions establish international humanitarian protections for prisoners of war and non-combatants.
context_excerpt: An international law treatise analyzing treaties and customary norms of armed conflict.
epistemic_summary: Legal validity is established by universal sovereign state ratification and intersubjective treaty obligations.
quote_evidences: Universal state ratification of the 1949 conventions binds nations to humane treatment standards as peremptory norms of international law.

claim_text: The Federal Reserve's 2 percent annual inflation target is the benchmark for price stability.
context_excerpt: An overview of modern central banking inflation targeting frameworks.
epistemic_summary: The numerical benchmark is an institutional convention established by central bankers rather than a natural physical law.
quote_evidences: The Federal Open Market Committee codified 2 percent as the explicit consensus target in its 2012 Statement on Longer-Run Goals.

claim_text: To state that 'snow is white is true' is simply an elaborate way of saying that snow is white.
context_excerpt: A philosophical seminar on Frank Ramsey and Paul Horwich's deflationary theory of truth.
epistemic_summary: The predicate 'is true' has no substantive metaphysical property and functions merely as a grammatical device of agreement.
quote_evidences: Asserting that a proposition is true adds nothing beyond making the bare assertion itself.

claim_text: When the speaker declares 'What she said was the absolute truth!', they are merely expressing full solidarity with her statement.
context_excerpt: A linguistic pragmatics paper analyzing performative utterances and endorsement markers in political discourse.
epistemic_summary: The truth label operates as a performative stamp of endorsement or rhetorical applause rather than a metaphysical attribution.
quote_evidences: Saying 'That's true!' is functionally equivalent to nodding vigorously or uttering 'I wholeheartedly agree!'

claim_text: Truth is not a mysterious cosmic property; calling an argument true is just a shorthand device for blind assent.
context_excerpt: An essay on semantic minimalism and redundancy theories of truth.
epistemic_summary: The concept of truth is deflated to a linguistic device for indirect quotation and generalization.
quote_evidences: We say 'Everything the witness said is true' because listing all fifty witness statements sequentially would be computationally prohibitive.

claim_text: The phrase 'It is undeniable truth that our team worked hard' is pure rhetorical emphasis meaning 'Our team worked hard.'
context_excerpt: A rhetoric handbook on intensifiers, pleonasms, and persuasive framing in corporate presentations.
epistemic_summary: Truth-predicates in this context act strictly as rhetorical amplifiers to persuade listeners.
quote_evidences: Prefacing a remark with 'It is true that' serves as an affective amplifier rather than a descriptor of an ontological property.

claim_text: The saying 'Speak your truth' is a modern idiom encouraging people to voice their personal convictions with conviction.
context_excerpt: A cultural linguistics commentary on contemporary idiom shifts and popular vernacular.
epistemic_summary: The word 'truth' is deflated into a rhetorical synonym for speaking honestly and expressing oneself.
quote_evidences: In conversational usage, 'your truth' functions not as an epistemological stance, but as a rallying cry for assertive self-expression.

claim_text: Saying 'Gold is malleable is true' possesses the exact same cognitive and truth-conditional content as 'Gold is malleable.'
context_excerpt: A philosophical monograph on T-schema equivalence and disquotational theories.
epistemic_summary: Disquotation eliminates the truth predicate entirely without any loss of propositional meaning.
quote_evidences: According to disquotationalism, the equivalence scheme 'P is true if and only if P' exhausts the entire content of the truth predicate.
